issue.title: Record the existing-task owner rule for capture & and * as a decisions strand

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by bob-cli-7r phases .1, .2, .3, .5, .6 and .7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes); deferred because epic bob-cli-7r's auto decision (no human review) was `decision_record = no`. Needs Bryan's explicit approval before any memory edit.

Add a new strand to the `decisions` web, e.g. `sase/memory/decisions/existing-task-owners-relate.md`, recording:

- **Claim.** `&` and `*` hang on the item's task: task text means a new task; an existing-task marker with no text means that task. Spellings: `@route+id` (canonical, leading or trailing), `@@route+id` (inherited), and the bare aliases `@route:id` and `^route:id`, which name the owner and never link it. A bare-owner (relationship-only) item refuses text-bearing extras (`p:`, `s:`, `%…`, child bullets) with the single shared `relationship_needs_text` message in both parse and execute. A Done or Canceled task can never block (`*` owner refused). `+`/`+query` beside `&`/`*` is the incomplete owner selector, never a task.
- **Why.** The §1 defects in plan:202610/capture_relate_existing_tasks.md (empty bullet on inherited owners, reopened closed `*` owners, junk `+`/`^route:id` inbox tasks, parse/execute disagreement). Rejected alternatives: linking through `@route:id *T`; applying `p:`/`s:` to the existing owner; a separate owner sigil.
- **Cost.** The non-linking aliases differ from the new-task `N @route:id *T` linking idiom; keeping a session alive needs the documented two-item idiom.
- **Reopens when.** Bryan wants alias linking or owners in unroutable notes.

Cite bob-cli commits 2f67276, 785d4ea, 2b884f5, 5a31133, 75a1809 and bob-mac-capture e41dee2, e5b2ef3 (plus the bob-cli-7r land tale's commits). Link `[[decisions:capture-star-blocks-existing-tasks]]` and `[[decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client]]`. Run `sase memory init`.

issue.creation_reason: Six bob-cli-7r phases proposed recording the accepted existing-owner relationship rules; the epic's unreviewed auto-decision skipped it, so Bryan should decide whether the decisions web gets the strand.
